additional_info.body:
Dear Nils-Christian,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
After carefully checking the charger, we identified the problem and performed a soft reboot on the chargers.
After this soft reboot, outlet 1 is working properly again, but the error code is still visible in the charger.
This is why the case will be forwarded to our technical team, who will carry out the necessary steps to resolve your issue.
With best regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: ID0467887-DC/Si-D/DE-[Multi] Connector Out of Service CRM:03209000024
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0467887
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Borchers Kreislaufwirtschaft
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset:
MP / S3 170003315
Charger ID / Serial No.:
4bHEcI & iWey6R
Charger address/functional location: Germany
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
Following your report, and after our checks and analysis, we found that the cause of the two errors was an FC18, FC20, FC21  issue in the 24V circuit. The charger is now back to normal operation.
However, if the issue related to FC18, FC20, FC21 reoccurs, please double-check the 24V circuit, verify any voltage drop, and replace components if necessary.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Priscilla van Wettum
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
